about: Sing Island World economy. Every timer has a real value and a fast value in seconds (the Fast switch: island 1 in about 10 minutes). Coin rates are coins per minute in the real game; Fast pays coins.fast_share of that number every second. Read by the web page and later by Unity.

coins.note: rate = per_minute_by_tier * (1 + level_step * (level-1)); a monster holds that many minutes (real) or seconds (Fast) of pay before its bubble is full

sell_duplicate.note: a bred monster the island already has is sold on hatching for these coins

levels.note: treats_to_next[L] = treats to go from level L to L+1 (index 0 unused); one feed = one level

times.note: seconds by child tier; the same time again in the Nursery to hatch

odds.note: Children are drawn from the union of both parents' elements. Weights: each parent's own species = parent; species strictly between the bigger parent's tier and the union = between; the union itself = union[tier] plus union_per_level for every level both parents have above the gate. Only species that live on the island count.

travel_egg.note: hatching the island's quad also puts a Travel Egg in the Nursery; it hatches after the quad so the lead sings first; hatching it opens the island's next island
